Anna (infra): heads up — running a quick region cost probe for APAC inference pools, found some weird egress + model-cache tail charges. cc @Mike (finance) @Priya
Mike (finance): thanks Anna. can you drop the numbers?
Anna (infra): quick summary first: APAC us-west-2-like region cheaper per-GPU but inter-region egress for model updates + cold-cache pulls is spiking monthly. suggests placement might be more expensive for bursty private customers.
Priya (eng-platform): are we looking at dedicated reserved SKUs vs flexible spot-like pools?
Anna (infra): yes. comparing: reserved L4/L8 commitments in ap-southeast vs on-demand in ap-east. also measured KV cache miss rate when models are sharded across regions.
Carlos (eng-ml): what's the cache miss rate? I assume large models (>30B) cause huge cold pulls.
Anna (infra): measured ~18% cross-region KV miss for 30B+ during peak deploys; cold-pull size ~= 6.4GB per host.
Jo (sre): that explains the TCP retrans and latency spikes we saw last week on the inference tier.
Anna (infra): pasted raw cost snippet from billing export (sanitized):
```
region,sku_type,commit_monthly_usd,avg_egress_usd,expected_monthly_gb,cold_pulls_per_month
ap-southeast,L8_reserved,42000,8500,12000,180
ap-east,L8_flex,48000,12000,15000,340
ap-southeast,L4_reserved,22000,4200,8000,210
ap-east,L4_flex,25000,6000,9500,390
```
Mike (finance): interesting — L8 flex in ap-east shows higher commit-equivalent cost when you add egress. are those egress numbers just public internet or inter-region too?
Anna (infra): inter-region (model sync + layer cache pulls) + some public egress for vendor telemetry. I separated them in analysis but short thread shows combined.
Priya (eng-platform): do we have per-customer QoS differences? e.g., PLG customers mostly hosted low-SLA vs enterprise with reserved lanes. Could route PLG to cheaper region even if egress slightly higher.
Carlos (eng-ml): also model architecture matters — quantized 4-bit variants reduce cold pull size ~45%. Could reduce egress by using quant variants for PLG buckets.
Jo (sre): ops risk: putting PLG in ap-southeast reduces latency for APAC but increases fallbacks to ap-east during local incidents due to capacity mismatch. We'd need cross-region fallback policies.
Mike (finance): propose we compute cost-per-effective-token including: commit amortized + egress amortized + estimated cache miss penalty. If APAC commit + cache penalty < APAC flex after all factors, commit.
Anna (infra): did that — here's a one-liner calc I ran (sanitized):
```
# cost_per_token ~ (commit_monthly + avg_egress_monthly + miss_penalty_monthly) / total_tokens_monthly
# sample: ap-southeast L8_reserved => (42000 + 8500 + 3200) / 2.1e9 = $0.0000246/token
# ap-east L8_flex => (48000 + 12000 + 7200) / 2.4e9 = $0.0000297/token
```
Priya (eng-platform): that delta is material at scale. we should also consider commit fungibility across AZs/regions for burst absorption.
Carlos (eng-ml): question: how often do cold-pulls happen? if we can pre-warm models during off-peak via cheap transfers, we might lower cold_pulls_per_month.
Anna (infra): cold pulls concentrated around deploy windows + weekly retrains. We can schedule staggered pre-warms, but that increases intra-region traffic briefly.
Jo (sre): automation idea: when a new model deploy is detected, trigger staged prefetch to local caches with rate limit. I'll prototype a controller.
Mike (finance): next steps from finance POV: 1) run the cost_per_token calc per-customer tier, 2) modelize risk (fallback latency), 3) evaluate a 12-month commit for ap-southeast L8 at current prices.
Priya (eng-platform): product/ops next steps: 1) policy: route PLG -> ap-southeast reserved + quantized defaults, 2) enterprise -> region on contract + prefer local reserved, 3) implement pre-warm controller.
Anna (infra): I'll share full CSV and the Cloud Billing queries in the doc. infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-2321 for pre-warm controller. :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: Ticket INFRA-2321 created by Anna (infra) — Pre-warm controller to stagger model cache population (link)
Mike (finance): tagging this for next week's cost review agenda. thanks team :raised_hands:
Priya (eng-platform): will add to the rollout playbook and surface a canary plan.
Anna (infra): thanks — will follow up with the sanitized billing query and a short runbook for commit thresholds.
Carlos (eng-ml): if you want I can run a sim of cache-hit improvements with quantized models and feed numbers to the ticket.
Anna (infra): please do. closing here for now. :wave:
